description: Run Google's on-device text-to-speech voices locally, with a command line and an HTTP server.
pre_uninstall: # The background server holds gttsw.exe open; stop it so the old version can be removed.
else { Get-Process gttsw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -like "$(appsdir $global)\$app\*" } | Stop-Process -Force }
post_install: # Point the sign-in entry at the 'current' folder so it survives updates, and restart it.
notes: Download the engine and voice packs (from Google's ChromeOS mirror), then start the HTTP server at sign-in:
The server listens on 127.0.0.1:5591. Downloaded voices are kept in %LOCALAPPDATA%\google-tts-local.
